tool_schemas.name: ask_human
tool_schemas.description: Ask your human principal a question, or request approval for one specific action before taking it (give action_tool and action_args). Humans are slow and costly: ask only when you genuinely need their knowledge or authority.

action_tool.description: Tool you want approval to call (optional).

args.question: Dana has no prior reservations on file, so I can't identify her "usual" hotel in New York from records. Which hotel should I book for her 2-night stay (check-in 2026-11-12)? Available options: Midtown Lodge ($189/night, $378 total), Harbor Inn ($239/night, $478 total), or Plaza Grand ($459/night, $918 total). Note: the flight is $289, so choosing Plaza Grand would put the trip total at $1,207, which exceeds the $1,000 threshold requiring manager approval.
